title: Separate customer-facing service identity from professional AI/common engines
ownerDecision: Customer and workspace pages use ekodi.kr/{public_namespace}/{service}. Customer-specific *.ai.ekodi.kr addresses are legacy-only. marketing.ekodi.kr is the shared Marketing Core, ai.ekodi.kr is the provider-independent AI Gateway/Orchestrator, and neither is the ordinary customer canonical entry.
constitutionalRules: User-facing URLs express the user/workspace/business and the requested service.
AI provider, model and orchestration topology must not define ordinary customer canonical URLs.
Customer-specific AI subdomains are forbidden as canonical addresses.
Professional AI/common engines may use justified registered subdomains but remain independent from customer identity.
Ordinary users do not need provider/model disclosure unless consent, safety, law or an explicit technical/admin context requires it.
EKODIBIZ Marketing AI public product canonical is https://ekodi.kr/ekodibiz/marketing-ai.
Workspace marketing surfaces use https://ekodi.kr/{public_namespace}/marketing, including https://ekodi.kr/jadam/marketing.
marketing.ekodi.kr is EKODI Marketing Core and consumes ai.ekodi.kr.
ai.ekodi.kr is the provider-independent EKODI AI Gateway and Orchestrator.

rollback.notes: The change is URL projection and governance only. Existing engine/runtime data and workspace_id identities are preserved. Legacy customer aliases remain available during transition.

approvalEvidence: EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly approved implementation in the 2026-09-03 conversation after confirming the customer-first URL and hidden-engine principle.
